objectives.label: Cut a big idea down to a first step

blocks.text: A project you can finish this month beats a perfect plan you never start. The first step should be small enough to do this week.

blocks.question: Which first step is small enough to finish this week?

options.label: Sketch one screen of the idea on paper
Wait until you have better tools

blocks.explanation: A paper sketch is one sitting of work and gives you something to react to. The other two options either never finish or never start.

blocks.title: Punchline
blocks.text: Progress you can see is progress you keep making.
